title: Portfolio construction of v8.6: three standard, low-parameter alternatives (strict rule)

trials.A EWMA vol target: the 30-day vol-targeting multiplier uses an exponentially weighted daily vol (half-life 10 days) instead of the 30-day window (same 15% target, cap 1.5, lagged one day)
trials.B blended vol target: the multiplier uses the mean of the 30-day and 90-day realised vol (less noise, slower)
trials.C equal risk contribution: monthly sleeve weights from equal risk contribution on the trailing-365-day daily covariance shrunk 50% toward its diagonal (Weiss expiry keeps half weight), instead of inverse-vol equal risk; same level and vol-target multipliers

rule: strict: every period (2022, TEST, HOLD) not lower and 2022-26 Sharpe +0.05 vs v8.6 3.110
